messages:
Maya: Heads up — nightly SAST run failed at 02:10 UTC. Scanner logs show repeated KMS errors: 'AccessDeniedException: call to KMS:Decrypt denied'. Blocking PR gating.
InfraBot: scan-runner-nightly #452 failed (exit=3) — see logs: https://internal-logs/reports/452 :warning:
Jared: Wasn't there an IAM tidy-up yesterday? I remember removing some broad decrypt perms from service accounts.
Lina: Correct. I trimmed the scanner service account to remove unused decrypt on cross-account keys — trying to follow least-priv. Looks like we accidentally removed the keystore key used by the SAST runner.
Maya: This is piling up in the merge queue. Can we do a scoped hotfix? Prefer not to revert policy entirely.
Jared: Plan suggestion: grant kms:Decrypt on the specific key ARN used by the scanner role only. Temporary escalation until we validate and add CI preflight. Need the exact key ARN — @Maya can you confirm which keystore the scanner needs? :eyes:
Maya: It's the repo-artifacts keystore: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
Lina: Ok. Two action items: 1) Apply minimal policy with kms:Decrypt on that key for role/scan-runner. 2) Add audit evidence (who changed it) and update runbook to include an IAM preflight check for scan runners.
Jared: I'll apply a temporary inline policy and then trigger a rerun. Command I'll use:
```
aws iam put-role-policy \
  --role-name scan-runner \
  --policy-name SAST-Scoped-KMS-Decrypt \
  --policy-document file://scanner-kms-policy.json
```
scanner-kms-policy.json (short):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:CalledVia": "sast-runner"}}
  }]
}
```
Lina: Nice — add a Condition for the scanner role's session tag if possible so it's not broadly usable. Also file an audit entry with the change reason and link to the ticket.
Maya: I'll open SEC-2026 and attach the logs + acceptance criteria. Once rerun passes, we should schedule removing the temporary policy and bake the preflight into CI.
DeployBot: iam-change: inline policy SAST-Scoped-KMS-Decrypt attached to role scan-runner by jared at 2026-03-23T02:25:10Z :white_check_mark:
Jared: Rerunning nightly now (kickoff job #453) — will report back. If green, we'll keep the policy <=24h and then rotate to long-term solution.
Lina: Follow-up: update sdlc/runbooks/keystore-access.md with steps, a verification script that runs `aws kms decrypt` with the role session, and an alert rule if >3 consecutive nightly failures. Also include a short postmortem checklist item: who approved the IAM change.
Maya: Great. Marking this thread high priority and tagging @infra for visibility. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jared: Job #453 passed. PR gating unblocked. Leaving the inline policy for 3 hours then removing and replacing with cross-account key grant scoped via attributes.
Lina: Please capture the audit log entry and link to SEC-2026 before revoking. I'll update the compliance checklist.
Maya: Closing once policy is rotated and audit is attached.
